svg.title: Bird Bend Stand wiring — sheet 4: HBS86H terminals, DIP switches (D-27), driver supply
svg.text: Sheet 4 — HBS86H terminals, DIP switches (D-27), driver supply
24–100 VDC / 18–70 VAC, run at 48 V DC
ALM reset = 48 V PSU off / on
set ONLY with the driver unpowered
← D1 (PA4 / U1) OR D2 (S0 NO, R_E, +5V_CUT)
ENA+ also: 10 kΩ pull-down → logic GND (sheet 3)
Control cable (Signal + OUT): shielded twisted pairs,
≥ 10 cm from motor / 48 V wires, cross at 90°;
shield → logic GND at the board end only.
Polarity (Leadshine, ASSUMED for the clone, C-07):
· ENA: LED current = DISABLED, none = enabled
· DIR: level set at the HW gate (motion.dir_invert)
ENA polarity of the PFDE clone ASSUMED
· PUL high / low ≥ 10 µs (FW default 12.5 µs)
DIP switches SW1…SW8 (D-27; 1 = ON) — apply the TARGET with the driver UNPOWERED
travel wizard measures the real value
= on off on off off on off on
found 2026-10-03: off on on on off on off off
(800 p/rev, CCW, assist on, open loop 6.0 A)
After the change: the first motion is a short slow jog that checks direction and scale (D-27, HG-28); record the state in every test report.
terminal names from the driver label (D-16 / D-27); verify against the unit before wiring
